notes.title: Patch v0.16
notes.content:
[h2]General[/h2]

[list]
[*] Updated card & tooltip descriptions
[*] History button now shows correctly all previous actions
[/list]

[h2]Visual[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added support for multiple different aspect ratios.
[*] Improved tooltips
[*] Improved inspect screen
[*] The size of the cards in hand is now larger
[*] Added pass counter to Kairos's card
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]

[b]Artemis[/b]
Stats changed: 4/0/8 -> 2/0/7

[b]Odin[/b]

Open the gates cooldown: 8 -> 6
Berserker: 4 mana 6/0/2 -> 3 mana 5/0/1
Wander: Move to an empty slot: range 3 -> Move to an empty slot: range 5

[b]Medusa[/b]

Stats changed: 3/0/7 -> 2/0/6
Pegasus: 2/0/6 -> 2/0/3

[b]Midas[/b]

Curse of Midas: manacost: 2 -> 1
Even from thin air: manacost: 3 -> 2


[b]Hecate[/b]

Spectral Hound: Now deals 4 piercing damage instead of 3 whenever it's owner discards a card

[b]Oracle[/b]

Stats changed: 3/0/8 -> 2/0/8
Foresight Flare: Now deals 4 piercing damage instead of 3 whenever it's owner plays a foresight card

[b]Kairos[/b]

Stats changed: 2/0/9 -> 3/0/9

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the game didn't end after a summon effect/passive that dealt damage to the tower
[*] Fixed game breaking bug regarding Kairos
[*] Fixed Ashen Lionguard not loosing it's buff, when the opposing unit is healed
[*] Fixed card flickering
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.15
notes.content:
[h1]Quality of life[/h1]

Tooltips implemented for handcards.
Reduced animation times.

[h1]Balance[/h1]

New Playable Paragon: [b]Sekhmet[/b]

[b]Kairos[/b]
Old ability: Deal 2 dmg to the opposing tower every time the opponent passes.
New ability: Kairos deals 12 damage to the enemy tower if the opponent passes four times in one turn.

A bag of opportunities: Manacost 8->7

[b]Fenrir[/b]

Unchained: Cooldown 7->6

notes.title: Minor dev patch
notes.content:
[h1]Features[/h1]

Basic lobby system implemented.

[h1]UI[/h1]

Added a useless button to the main menu, called: Quit.

notes.title: Patch v0.14a
notes.content:
[h1][b]General[/b][/h1]

Added option to change the quality settings

[h1][b]Balance[/b][/h1]

[b]Asclepius[/b]

Removed card from his pool: Heal the Wound
Added new card: Vitality -- 3 cost spell, Grant target unit 3 health and then heal it for 3

[b]General[/b]

The following spells and abilities are now dealing piercing damage:
Dagger from below
Bandit chief's ability: Call the crew
Recurring nightmares

[h1][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h1]

Fixed bug, where Pele didn't gain her extra power targeting a tower, this occured when a unit in front of her just died.
Fixed bug, where Ruina was dealing 2 damage on her summon effect instead of 5.
